title: A Pocket Inside Your Pocket. For What?
parts: What is that tiny pocket inside your jeans pocket for?
Levi Strauss and Company says it was intended to store a pocket watch.
In eighteen seventy-three, Jacob Davis received a United States patent, shared with Levi Strauss's company.
People call it the fifth pocket.
The company says that title belongs to the back left pocket, which appeared in nineteen oh one.
During the Second World War, the company removed the rivets from the watch pocket, to save metal.
The company's own article does not say.
